notes.title: Come and Get It!
notes.content:
These valuable items can now be obtained from the UFO wreck: 
- Blue Crystals	
- Red Crystals
- Fungus
- Aether
- Glitter

There are always 1-5 of these inside the wreck and they can be collected by placing a Hovercraft over the wreck!

notes.title: Major Update: The Flow of Goods
notes.content:
"I have never seen anything like this!", says the Cadet

Take your gaming experience to a new level:
- Each colony has a Star Portal that acts as connection to the market for buying and selling the goods.
- The flow of commodities and units through the Aether Pipes has been visualized.
- Storaged units are visualised.
- Mobilization and selling of the units is done through the Aether Pipes.
- The buildings now have input and output cells for consumption and production.

notes.title: We are working on a Major Update!
notes.content: Here is a glimpse. Guess what it is?

notes.title: Zoom and Boom
notes.content:
Zoom: You can now select Close Up, Normal or Strategic camera view by pressing '1', '2' or '3'.

Boom: Optimize your colony's finances, prosperity and welfare by selecting from these budget models:
 - 14 new tax models added 
 - 7 new wage models added
 - 7 new fee settings added for Schools, Colleges, Hospitals and Habitation Modules

notes.title: Here's a tip!
notes.content:
Massive amount of tooltips has been added. This information will give you complete control of the genre-defining Management Real Time Strategy game.

Also in the new release:
- When mouse cursor is over a skill symbol (Knowledge or Practical Skill) on the top bar, the skill level of workforce is shown in addition to all colonists' skill level.
- Explorer unit tries to find a new route to the target and continue if it faces an obstacle during exploring.
- If there are multiple family members living in a Habitation Module, they now pay the rent together.
- Finance Panel font colors updated.
